memes: Saxophone Gets Louder: TikTok spiral format where a calm situation escalates into a full 80s-sax blast and freeze-frame — the universal template for any slow-burn disaster.
My American Girl Doll audio: creators borrow a 2009 kid's earnest doll intro to reveal their most-prized or most-embarrassing grown-up obsession.
How Could This Day Get Any Better: ironic reveal format where someone treats something completely tiny — a free sample, a good parking spot — as a lottery win.
2026 is the new 2016: nostalgia wave of reposting 2016 fashion, Tumblr aesthetics, and pop hits with Gen-Z reclaim energy across TikTok and YouTube.
Chinamaxxing / Becoming Chinese: earnest lifestyle trend of adopting Chinese food, philosophy, and daily habits, generating waves of sincere 'day in my life' content.
Jimothy the raccoon: a short-spine Seattle raccoon treated as a national mood board, captioned as 'me at work,' 'a Monday,' or 'a small business that refuses to close.'
